caveats: No official player ratings on the web path: best and worst player are Scout's pick. BBC's average ratings are fan submissions and are not used as ratings.
ESPN lists Verbruggen on 7 saves while City had 6 shots on target (ESPN Shots on Goal 6): saves figure is quoted as ESPN gives it.
ESPN commentary calls Haaland's blocked shot his 'only chance' but the ESPN shot map lists 4 Haaland shots: shot map used for counts.
Shot-map xG sums to 1.93 for City (rounding); official 1.92 from ESPN team stats / BBC used.
Streaks (25 league games without a blank, 16 previous visits, winless in five) come from the BBC report text only; trend-scout must verify before they are used on screen.
